newsitem.title: UK: Emery opens UK southern coast service centr.
newsitem.headline: Emery opens UK southern coast service centr.

text.p: Emery Worldwide has opened a new service centre in the Portsmouth/Southampton area to cover key industrial areas along the UK South Coast.
Emery in a press release said the unit which includes warehouse storage and dedicated pickup and delivery vehicles, will help growth in Southern UK.

The centre covers Southampton, Weymouth, Brighton, Eastbourne, Andover, Poole, Portsmouth and the Isle of Wight and will be under the regional management of Ray Johnson, Emery's General Manager (London) Southern Region .

Based at Portsmouth's Enterprise Centre close to the M27 and M3 motorways, it offers international services including global door-to-door express and air cargo consolidations, intra-European delivery, ocean freight forwarding and the company's logistics management services. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
